newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov. taps Democrat to head power authority.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov. taps Democrat to head power authority.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki said Friday he named Richard Kessel chairman of Long Island Power Authority (LIPA).

Kessel, a Democrat who had served as head of the authority from 1989 to 1995, replaces Frank Zarb who left the post as chairman to lead the Washington-based National Association of Securities Dealers.

The new LIPA chairman served on the Authority's board as a trustee after he was replaced as chairman, and Kessel worked closely with Zarb in reaching a pact unveiled last month that the Republican governor has said would cut electricity rates by 20 percent for Long Island residents.

"I intend to do the best job I can to get the rate reduction Long Islanders want and deserve," said Kessel, in prepared remarks. He added. "As his (Zarb's) partner, I will continue his fair leadership so that Long Islanders benefit now and in the future."
